;Business and economy 
*[[Qatar]] announces that it is withdrawing from [[OPEC]] in January 2019, after almost 60 years of membership, to focus on [[natural gas]] production. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2018/dec/03/qatar-pulls-out-of-opec-to-focus-on-gas-production (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*The FBI raids the house of [[Mayors of Atlantic City, New Jersey|Atlantic City Mayor]] [[Frank Gilliam (politician)|Frank Gilliam]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/03/nyregion/mayor-frank-gilliam-atlantic-city.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush]]
**The body of former [[President of the United States|President]] [[George H. W. Bush]] arrives on [[Special Air Mission]] from [[Houston]] to [[Washington, DC]] at the [[Joint Base Andrews]].  [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna942936 (NBC News)] [https://abcnews.go.com/US/schedule-george-hw-bushs-funeral-includes-trip-capitol/story?id=59555460 (ABC News)]
**The [[United States Postal Service]] announces it will suspend regular mail deliveries, retail services and administrative office activity on December 5 as part of President Trump's declared national day of mourning. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/03/politics/us-postal-service-suspend-deliveries-h-w-bush-national-mourning/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2017-18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Jailed Catalan independentists leaders [[Joaquim Forn]] and [[Josep Rull]] joins [[Jordi Sànchez|Sànchez]] and [[Jordi Turull|Turull]] in the hunger strike. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/two-more-jailed-catalan-separatist-leaders-join-hunger-strike-idUSKBN1O22BB (''Reuters'')]
;Science and technology 
*[[2018 in spaceflight]]
**[[NASA]]'s space probe [[OSIRIS-REx]] arrives at the asteroid [[101955 Bennu|Bennu]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/03/science/osiris-rex-bennu-asteroid-arrival.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Soyuz MS-11]] successfully launches from the [[Baikonur Cosmodrome]] in [[Kazakhstan]] carrying [[Roscosmos]] cosmonaut [[Oleg Kononenko]], [[NASA]] astronaut [[Anne McClain]], and [[Canadian Space Agency|CSA]] astronaut [[David Saint-Jacques]] for [[Expedition 58]] to the [[International Space Station]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/canada-saint-jacques-launch-soyuz-1.4929760 (CBC)]

;Sport
*[[2018 Ballon d'Or]]
**In [[association football]], Croatian midfielder [[Luka Modrić]] wins the [[Ballon d'Or]] and becomes the first player other than [[Lionel Messi]] or [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] to win the award since [[Kaká]] in 2007. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-ballon/soccer-modric-wins-2018-ballon-dor-breaks-messi-ronaldo-dominance-idUSKBN1O22KR (Reuters)]
**Norwegian striker [[Ada Hegerberg]] wins the inaugural [[Ballon d'Or Féminin|Women's Ballon d'Or]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/dec/03/ballon-dor-ada-hegerberg-twerk-luka-modric (''The Guardian'')]
